question: Which country became the eighth to accept UPI payments, starting with duty-free outlets at its Airport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Qatar has become the eighth country to accept UPI payments, starting with duty-free outlets at Hamad International Airport in Doha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian tourists can now use UPI apps like PhonePe, Google Pay, and BHIM at select locations in Qatar, simplifying payments and reducing reliance on foreign currency.**
 
• **This partnership between NIPL, Qatar National Bank (QNB), and NETSTARS facilitates real-time, cashless payments in Qatar.**
 
• **The move is expected to boost Qatar’s retail and tourism sectors by catering to the high-spending Indian tourist base.**
 
• **Qatar joins countries like Bhutan, Nepal, Singapore, and the UAE in adopting UPI for Indian users, showcasing UPI’s growing global presence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UPI in Qatar__ **

 __
 
• **UPI’s rollout in Qatar started with the Qatar Duty Free at Hamad International Airport, with plans to expand to other tourist locations, hotels, and restaurants.**
 
 ** **
 
• **UPI’s Global Reach__ **
 __
 
• **Qatar becomes the eighth country to adopt UPI, joining a growing list that includes Bhutan, Nepal, Singapore, and the UAE.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Indian Tourists’ Benefits__ **
 __
 
• **Indian tourists in Qatar can make real-time payments using UPI apps, eliminating the need for foreign currency and ensuring secure transactions.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Partnership for Integration__ **
 
 
• **The integration of UPI in Qatar was enabled by a partnership between NIPL, QNB, and NETSTARS, ensuring smooth and secure payment operations.**
 
 ** **
